mapper.select: SELECT id,status,message,started_at,duration_ms FROM runs WHERE user_id=#{userId} ORDER BY started_at DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total,COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status='success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS success_count FROM runs WHERE user_id=#{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total,COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status='success' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0) AS success_count FROM runs WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND started_at>=#{cutoff}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM runs WHERE user_id=#{userId} AND status=#{status}
